British Values
Subject Principles
How Do We Teach British Values At East Coker School?
British Values are embedded across the school in a range of ways which include: our school ethos and values; direct teaching; cross curricular themes; events and visitors to the school.
British values is addressed through specific lessons which will encourage discussion and debate and these will be taught specifically Religious Education, Computing, PSHE, English and History. In upper key stage two children learn about power (government and monarchy) across the history curriculum and discuss the way this impacts on society. In Religious Education we ensure an understanding of a wide range of different faiths and cultures. In English we use class novels as an opportunity to teach about diversity within Britain. We look at online safety and being responsible IT citizens in our computing curriculum.
In addition to lesson British Values is embedded in our school culture through our School Council, Year 6 Ambassadors programme, House Captains and House Meetings and our use of Buddies. We also hold special event and celebrations which celebrate differences, equality, tolerance and responsibility.

East Coker Community Primary School
Welcome
We are a seven class village school with a very friendly and caring ethos. The school is set in beautiful surroundings in the village of East Coker which is just on the edge of Yeovil. We have fantastic facilities both in and around school and there is always lots going on for our pupils. This website aims to give you an overview of the school, as well as providing up to date information for parents, pupils and the wider community.
East Coker Community Primary School is a middle sized school for pupils aged between 4 - 11 years. Our core catchment is the village of East Coker together with the surrounding villages of East Chinnock, Pendomer and Hardington as well as an area of Yeovil. A growing proportion of our pupils come to us from outside this catchment area from other villages and other parts of Yeovil. Our annual admission number is 30 pupils and we currently have approximately 200 pupils on roll. We have a very good staff to pupil ratio.
We run Kingfishers Breakfast Club and After School Club (7.30am - 6pm) on site in safe, secure, well lit grounds, led by our experienced and very creative teaching assistants. You can find out more information about this in our Parents section.
We also offer many after school clubs such as art, a range of sports and music as well as provide opportunities for our children to take part in external events such as clay workshops with professional artists and competitive sports events. In addition to this we have educational visits and residentials. These include visits to the theatre, farm, seaside, museums and engineering events.
We have a very active PTFA who raise funds so our children can have many additional experiences such as free music lessons for Year 3 pupils, two external theatre productions and workshops as well as subsidising our many school visits. We have exciting events throughout the year from bingo to discos, to our very popular summer fair.
We hope that you enjoy your visit to our website, and that you find the information you are looking for. Please feel free to contact the school directly with any queries you may have. This includes requests for paper copies of any information we have on the website.
Mrs Jane Hesketh-Williams

East Coker Community Primary School
Kingfishers Breakfast & After School Clubs, Summer Holiday Club
Welcome to our wrap around care page. We deliver our own wrap around care at Kingfishers club which is on the school site. The provision is run by school staff and the children have full use of the outdoor adventure play equipment, playgrounds and field to play sports, ride bikes and scooters and use the lunchtime den building and builders yard play areas. In addition to this we have lots of crafts and games indoors and use of the school hall on wet days.
For bookings please use My Child At School App. Contact the office for further information. WE ACCEPT TAX FREE CHILDCARE VOUCHERS including the government vouchers, Edenred, Computershare and Care4. If you use another provider please contact the school to see if we can include this to our provider list.

French
Curriculum Subjects
French Subject Principles
How Do We Teach French At East Coker School?
At East Coker School we follow the National Curriculum for Languages and teach languages from Year 3 to Year 6. We mainly teach French as that is a language on offer at most secondary school Modern Foreign Language departments.
We believe in ensuring the curriculum is ambitious, and that it will inspire and excite our pupils through delivering a wide variety of topics and themes. Lessons are practical and engaging and content is based on familiar routines that pupils can relate to in their everyday lives. There is a focus on developing a bank of key vocabulary to use in conversation and writing. Pupils are taught the sounds of the French alphabet to help them read words in French.
To support with the delivery of French, we use Primary Languages Network as well as other resources, for years 3-6. Our French lessons incorporate a wide range of learning activities, such as songs, rhymes, interactive games, word matching and role play. These activities ensure that pupils are consistently and actively engaged in their learning, building confidence in their ability to speak and write French as they progress through the school. This will enable pupils to use and apply their learning in a variety of contexts, laying down solid foundations for future language learning.
French Progression Framework

Reception Starters for 2027
Welcome to East Coker Primary School
Thank you for considering East Coker Primary School. We offer face to face tours and chats with the Head Teacher which you can arrange by contacting the school office. Our tours are usually led by our Year 6 Ambassadors so you get a feel for what school will be like for your child. It is then followed by a chat with the Head Teacher or Deputy Head. Appointments are available from Monday 12th October 2026, please contact the school for further information. We also have a Saturday opening morning which usually takes place on Saturday 3rd October. This drop in open morning is in addition to our tours so you can have a really good look around and a chat with the staff.
Please look a the links on our main admissions page for further information. If you would like to book a tour and chat with the Head Teacher, please contact the school office on: 01935 862532 or email us at office@eastcokerprimary.org
